message: `watchEffect` created inside a repeating watcher callback is not stopped when that callback ends
help: Keep the inner stop handle, register it with `onCleanup` / `onWatcherCleanup`, or re-enter an owner `scope.run` (outer 6:1, source 8:26). The first immediate run may be scope-owned; later callbacks still leak.

message: `watchEffect` only tracks `inner.value`; prefer `watch` with an explicit source
help: Use `watch(() => inner.value, …, { immediate: true, flush: 'sync' })` to preserve the first run and sync flush.
